## Safety and evidence

- [ ] The lab uses only synthetic or public data—no secrets or identifying records.
- [ ] Reproduce/Break: a machine-valid Challenge receipt, result, note, and scenario id are committed.
- [ ] Adapt: the Gallery entry has valid `challenge.id`, `track`, and `claim` metadata.
- [ ] The zero-cost mock command runs from a clean checkout.
- [ ] Reproduce: the claim and divergent scenario are linked.
- [ ] Break: new programmatic ground truth and an observed failure are committed.
- [ ] Adapt: Forge provenance, a contract blueprint, and protected authority are explicit.
- [ ] I understand that Challenge status is repository evidence, not production or regulatory approval.
